changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE public.clients ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, client_id VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL, client_secret VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, scopes VARCHAR(255) );

changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE public.ponto_dispensacao ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, cnes VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL, nome VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, tipo VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL CHECK (tipo IN ('FARMACIA_CENTRAL', 'FARMACIA_MUNICIPAL', 'ALMOXARIFADO')), email_responsavel VARCHAR(255) );

changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE public.lote ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, numero_lote VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, insumo_id BIGINT NOT NULL, data_validade DATE, data_fabricacao DATE, quantidade INT, FOREIGN KEY (insumo_id) REFERENCES public.insumo(id) );
